description: The language book: words and their mastery bands, grammar patterns and weaknesses, conversations and fluency (thousandths), the CEFR band; and the player's CEFR facts (src/language-learning/progress.ts, src/prolog/player-language-state.ts).
comparison: exact, object key sets included (a key TypeScript leaves undefined is absent); an unknown op or step is an error, never a skip

cases.name: mastery: bands from encounters and weighted halves
cases.note: floor(halves / 2) is the weighted count: 3 learning, 5 familiar, 8 mastered; below 3, two encounters still make learning, one is new.

cases.name: gain: the parts, the bonuses and the diminishing multiplier, in thousandths
cases.note: Base min(500, 150 per turn), vocabulary min(2000, 200 per word), grammar 300/150/50, length min(500, 50 per turn), immersion 500 at 80%, 200 at 50%; × (200000 − fluency) / 200000, floored; clamped 100..3000.

cases.name: run: encounters build the book; a word is per language and ignores case; exposure is not a correct use
run: a word climbs learning, familiar and mastered as its weighted uses reach 3, 5 and 8
run: the bus events the book hears, and one it does not
cases.note: vocabulary_used is an active use or a wrong answer; object_examined a reading in the event's language; vocabulary_overheard a hover; object_named a right or wrong answer. Anything else is somebody else's evidence.

cases.name: run: grammar corrections create patterns, a clean turn reinforces them, and a weakness is announced once
cases.note: A weakness is ≥ 4 attempts at an error rate ≥ 2/5, and it is announced only on a slip that crosses it (the tracker checks only there). Article agreement reaches 2 right and 2 wrong on a clean turn: weak, but not announced, and a further slip does not announce it either. Past tense crosses on its third slip (1 right, 3 wrong): announced, with the bus's fractional errorRate.

cases.name: run: five right uses master a pattern and a slip unmasters it
run: a conversation moves fluency, counts new and reinforced words, and raises the band one step
cases.note: At A1 with 19800 fluency, a 10-turn conversation with 5 different words, 9 of 10 right and 85% French earns 500 + 1000 + 300 + 500 + 500 = 2800, × (200000 − 19800) / 200000 = 2522: 22322 passes A2's floor of 20000. Words used twice count twice as new when unseen.

cases.name: run: with no band, fluency never raises one; at C2 there is no next band; fluency stops at 100000 while the gain is still reported
run: an assessment sets the band, raises fluency to its floor, and announces only a change
cases.note: The first band is set silently (there was none). B1 lifts 3000 to 40000; A2 keeps 40000 (a lower band never lowers fluency) and is announced; A2 again is not.

cases.name: facts: the CEFR band from player_cefr_level, upper-cased; explicit weak areas
facts: no weak_area facts, weak dimensions derived below 60, lowest first; a band that is not one is none
facts: a custom threshold ignores weak_area facts and derives
